## Change summary

Describe the user-visible behavior or operational fix and linked issue.

## Validation

- [ ] Typecheck, tests, database integration and build verified in GitHub Actions
- [ ] Security and per-user authorization considered where applicable
- [ ] No secrets or production data in commits

## Vercel deployment budget

- [ ] Intermediate changes grouped into a coherent push where practical
- [ ] Hosted preview is actually needed for this change (or explain why not)
- [ ] No manual deploy retries or production configuration changes

Preview needed? **No / Yes** — Reason:

## Rollout risks

Describe any migrations, env changes, compatibility risks or manual activation.

## Autonomous batch and merge readiness

Development front / existing PR checked:

Related tasks completed (target 5–10):

- [ ] Existing PR reused or reason for a new PR documented
- [ ] Final head CI green; required reviews and branch protection satisfied
- [ ] Squash merge appropriate; no draft, unresolved review, or known security blocker
- [ ] Authentication, database, permissions, secrets or production changes flagged for additional validation
- [ ] Rollback and compatibility plan included where needed
- [ ] No preview deployment unless explicitly justified

Risk level: **Low / Medium / High**

Auto-merge eligible? **No / Yes** — only after confirming repository settings and protections; never for high-risk changes.
